title: worker erlang c
summary: A CI intake service receives jobs as a Poisson process at 4 jobs per minute. Each identical worker has exponential service time with mean 40 seconds (rate 1.5 jobs per minute). Jobs wait in one shared FIFO queue. The SLO requires mean queueing delay, before service, no more than 30 seconds. The team must choose the smallest stable integer worker count supported by this queueing model.
